title: AI leak-detection competitors in Europe

input.targetCustomerType: competing vendors (for landscape mapping, not as customers)
input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Map the competitive landscape to sharpen positioning and messaging
constraints: exclude pure hardware with no software

marketSignals: competitor-development should be the dominant signalType
Should capture each competitor's apparent positioning, not just its name
candidates: organisationType should be 'competitor' here, not a utility type
Each competitor needs relevance evidence (what they sell, to whom)
mustAvoid: Treating competitors as sales targets / suggesting outreach to them
Listing companies with no verifiable software offering
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: Company websites and analyst/trade coverage; flag marketing claims as interpretation, not fact

notes: Tests that the same machinery serves a positioning goal, and that fact-vs-interpretation stays clean when sources are vendor self-description.
